decisions.reason: The firm has invested in a multi-model laser workstation line that builds on its core laser marking competence, and since it launched only in 2023, any weak early results can still be put down to market ramp-up, so management will persist with it.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer has its own website page, which signals visible public commitment, and it fits the single-source, surface-matched coding portfolio the firm has announced, so dropping it after one year is unlikely.

The piezo inkjet printer was developed in-house, is publicly featured on its own page, and is central to the firm's broad technology-matching strategy, so sunk costs and the need to justify the launch favor keeping it.
